summary: First full test run of Game Config Patcher. Backend: created pytest suite (/app/backend/tests/backend_test.py) with 16 tests covering catalog listing/seed data, categories, search (title + app_id), category filter, game CRUD (multipart create, cover-file create, PUT update, soft delete), file upload (lua + dll), invalid file_type, file removal, injection package targets, object-storage download of real bytes, and 404/422 error paths — 16/16 passed. Frontend: Playwright e2e on the public URL covering library grid (4 seeded cards, covers all loaded, APPID tag, DLL/LUA counts), debounced search by title and app_id, category filter, Simulate Inject toasts with correct Windows target paths, Add Game -> redirect to manage, .lua upload -> file row -> remove -> re-upload, edit save + persistence, delete, required-field validation, Settings paths/apiBase, and navigation. All frontend flows passed. Only issue found: unhandled clipboard rejection on Settings copy buttons.

minor.issue: Accepts any arbitrary storage path (no prefix validation against APP_NAME). Any object in the storage bucket can be fetched by guessing/knowing a path. Consider validating path.startswith(APP_NAME + '/').
No uniqueness validation on app_id — duplicate App IDs can be created, and the frontend uses app_id in data-testid/card identity.
Soft-deletes without filtering is_deleted=False, so deleting an already-deleted game returns 200 instead of 404 (cosmetic/idempotency).

ui_bugs.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() promise is not caught. When clipboard permission is denied (headless/insecure context), an uncaught 'NotAllowedError: Write permission denied' bubbles up, triggering the CRA runtime-error overlay which then blocks all clicks on the page. Wrap in try/catch (or .catch) with a fallback + error toast.

For games whose cover was uploaded as a file (cover_url = /api/files/download?path=...), the edit form sets form.cover_url='' and the PUT sends cover_url:'' — backend only filters None, so saving wipes the existing cover. Repro: create game with cover file, open manage, click Save Changes, cover disappears.
Cover image file upload is unsupported when editing (only a toast message is shown); the cover-file-input is hidden in edit mode. Backend has no multipart cover-update endpoint.
File size shows '0.0 KB' for small files (<50 bytes) due to (size/1024).toFixed(1); show bytes when < 1 KB.

issues: Sidebar keeps its full fixed width at tablet width, squeezing the grid to 2 narrow columns and forcing 'Simulate Inject' to wrap onto two lines. Consider collapsing the sidebar to icons below lg.
Hidden <input type=file> elements carry data-testid but are class=hidden; automated tests must use state='attached' (noted for future test agents, not a defect).

action_items: Wrap navigator.clipboard.writeText in try/catch with fallback in Settings.js (uncaught rejection blocks the whole page via CRA overlay).
Fix cover wipe on edit: don't send empty cover_url in PUT (or have backend ignore empty strings), so file-uploaded covers survive a Save Changes.
Optional: support cover replacement while editing (multipart PUT or dedicated /games/{id}/cover endpoint).
Optional: restrict /api/files/download to paths under APP_NAME and validate app_id uniqueness on create.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_game filters only None values; empty strings from the frontend overwrite existing data (cover_url regression).
download_file has no path scoping — arbitrary object read within the storage namespace.
Every clipboard/async browser API call in the UI should have a rejection handler; one unhandled rejection renders the app unusable in dev builds.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all core flows pass; clipboard copy raises uncaught error)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted a test game (title TEST_UI Game / app_id 999123) via the UI, plus TEST_ prefixed games via pytest (auto-cleaned by fixture, soft-deleted). Library is back to the 4 seeded games.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md exists but app has no auth; not needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/backend_test.py -v). Object storage (Emergent) put/get works end-to-end; downloaded bytes match uploads. Electron client in /app/desktop was not tested (Windows-only). When testing file uploads in Playwright, wait with state='attached' because dll/lua inputs are class='hidden'. Avoid clicking Settings copy buttons until the clipboard rejection is fixed — it raises the CRA error overlay which intercepts all subsequent clicks.
rca_of_the_issue: Clipboard bug: Settings.copy() calls navigator.clipboard.writeText(text) without awaiting/catching; in a non-permitted context the returned promise rejects with NotAllowedError, surfacing as an uncaught runtime error and rendering the webpack-dev-server overlay iframe which intercepts pointer events. Cover-wipe bug: GameManage sets form.cover_url='' for non-http covers and PUT /api/games/{id} only strips None values, so '' is persisted over the stored cover path.
